name: Priya Nair
text: Hello, I own my house in Clifton and I would like a full garden design. My budget is $12,000 and I need it done this week if possible, the family arrives Friday. I make the decisions on this, so please come back to me directly.

name: Marcus Webb
text: Hi, looking for regular lawn care for our place. We have set aside $6,500 for the season. Next month would be a good start. It is my house and my call, happy to book a visit.

name: Elena Petrova
text: I am writing on behalf of my manager, who asked me to get quotes for tree surgery on two overgrown oaks. We could spend about $2,000. No rush at all, whenever you have space in the diary.

name: Tom Ellery
text: We want a patio build at the back of the house. I have eight thousand dollars put aside for it and it is urgent, the old one is unsafe. I own the property, send the quote to me.

name: Sana Iqbal
text: Our irrigation system has failed and the beds are drying out, it is urgent. I can spend $9,000. It is my garden and my decision. One thing: can you do 25% off if we sign this week?

name: David Osei
text: Planning a garden design in two phases. Phase one is $4,000 this spring, and the total budget for the whole project is $11,000. Starting next month works for us. I own the house and I will sign off on the plan.

name: Grace Liu
text: Our lawn care contract ends abruptly and we need cover urgently, this week ideally. I run the residents association and I can approve the spend, but I have not been given a figure yet.

name: Henrik Dahl
text: I am gathering quotes for my parents for a garden design at their home. They have $15,000 available. Timing is flexible, sometime before summer. They will decide, I am just helping them compare.

name: Fatima Noor
text: A storm split our big tree and it is hanging over the fence, this is urgent. We can manage $3,500. I am asking for my landlord, he pays and he decides, I just need it made safe.

name: Jack Morrison
text: Full patio build with lighting, top spec. Budget is $20,000 and I want it started this week. My house, my money, my decision. Call me and let us get it booked.

name: Aiko Tanaka
text: We would like irrigation installed across the vegetable beds. I have $7,200 for the work. Sometime this spring is fine, no urgency. I own the plot and I decide on spending like this.

name: Anonymous
text: How much do you charge? Send prices please.
